Lemma
[The horizontal lift is smooth in tangent coordinates]

↗ lem:horizontal-lift-smooth-in-data ↗ def:horizontal-lift-tangent ↗ lem:horizontal-lift-linear-spec

For a submersion of $(\tilde M,\tilde g)$ and $x_0\in \tilde M$, the family $L_x:T_{\pi (x)}M\to T_x\tilde M$ is smooth at $x_0$ when read in tangent coordinates at $x_0$ and $\pi (x_0)$.

Proof

↗ lem:horizontal-lift-smooth-in-data ↗ def:horizontal-lift-tangent ↗ lem:horizontal-lift-linear-spec \sketch In tangent trivializations, $L_x$ is the lift of the smooth families representing $\tilde g_x$ and $d\pi _x$. Their value at $x_0$ is positive definite and surjective, so Lemma 2 applies.

□
